verdict.rationale: MoonPay's first-party docs describe outbound webhook events sent to your application for account activity and asynchronous transaction status updates [moonpay-docs-11, moonpay-docs-65]. They also document a specific event, sell_transaction_requote_required, for in-app requote handling [moonpay-docs-12, moonpay-docs-66]. A community user's question about where webhook events are listed is an open question, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: a documented full event catalog, endpoint registration/subscription and signature-verification details, and independent hands-on corroboration.
